title: Reconstruction from Circuit Parts
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and an output vertex. Each gate at position $i$ reads only vertices with index less than $n+i$, and the output index is less than $n$ plus the number of gates. Constructing a circuit from the number of inputs, the gate list of $C$, and its output index returns exactly $C$.
